summary: Fixed QA-1 (R5): the code-splitting is now proven by a test that fails if any on-demand module is eagerly imported, and the Help/Update dialog bodies are no longer carried by the initial view. App.tsx now lazy-loads the whole UpdateUI module (UpdateBanner, UpdateDialog, UpdateSettingsBlock) and a new HelpDialog export; the Help body moved out of App.tsx into src/features/command-palette/CommandPalette.tsx so it shares the palette's on-demand chunk. Each is wrapped in Suspense with a null/panel fallback, and the Utilities trigger keeps the update version visible immediately. Added src/App.test.tsx 'R5: optional panels and the help/update dialog bodies are loaded only when opened, not with the initial view', which uses vi.mock evaluation probes to assert ConsoleNav, EditPane, GitDrawer, ThemeFinder, CommandPalette (palette + Help) and UpdateUI are not evaluated while App's module graph loads, then opens Help and proves the palette chunk loads only then; verified it fails when GitDrawer is made an eager import. Updated docs/ui-tidy-up-plan.md §3 and §7 (D8/D9 plus the load table) to record the Help and Update bodies as lazy. No Rust, src/api, permission, CSP or dependency changes. npm run lint clean, npm test 389 passing in 42 files, npm run build succeeds; the built main chunk no longer contains the Help text and UpdateUI/CommandPalette are separate chunks.
